epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce Docker Compose boot failures due to unresolvable MinIO image tag from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: Fix the unresolvable MinIO image tag RELEASE.2023-09-20T22-40-07Z in the Docker Compose runtime to allow successful boot.

slices.title: Update MinIO image tag in Docker Compose
slices.jtbd: When implementing the MinIO image tag fix for this epic, I want to update the docker-compose.yml configuration, so that technical debt is eliminated and infrastructure standards are strictly upheld.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Docker Compose environment is configured
When the runtime attempts to pull the MinIO image
Then it uses a resolvable tag instead of RELEASE.2023-09-20T22-40-07Z
Given the MinIO image is pulled
When the Docker Compose stack is started
Then the object-storage container boots successfully without not found errors
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce MinIO image pull failure rate from 100% to 0%
